name: ALK receptor tyrosine kinase

function.text: ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in developmental signaling, with downstream effects on cell growth, survival, and differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neuroblastoma, susceptibility to, 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Cutaneous melanoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; ALK-positive histiocytosis. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
